speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what is the target number of students expected to be trained through the new Master of Science in Holistic Palliative Care programme; (b) what employment opportunities and career progression in our public healthcare system are available for graduates; and (c) what other initiatives is the Ministry undertaking to broaden and improve palliative care education for healthcare professionals.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Healthcare professionals are equipped with knowledge on palliative care in two ways.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: What alternative pathways or continuing education programmes are being considered to equip existing healthcare professionals with palliative skills?

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: And a short response, please, Senior Parliamentary Secretary Rahayu.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: As I mentioned earlier, there are already existing frameworks and specialisations that the healthcare workers can go into.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, these are some of the examples which healthcare workers who are interested in these, can pivot into and learn more about in the palliative care sector.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Order of the Day.

speaker: Mr Speaker
